purpose: Concept presentations, not production icon exports

concepts.title: Fork W
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE icon-first logo concept for Forkware, a recipe and meal planning iOS app. Direction: Fork W. A clever bold W monogram that also reads as the head of a dining fork. Three or four upright prongs merge into a sculpted W-shaped base. Compact almost-square silhouette; no long handle. One unified shape.
Create a polished square concept presentation on pure white. Main subject: a large iOS-style rounded-square app icon tile, dark warm charcoal fill, with the symbol in flat warm ivory. Keep all essential symbol geometry centered within the middle 65 percent of the tile, ample optical safe area, robust thick shapes and large gaps. No text or letters other than the explicitly requested monogram inside the icon. Flat two-color design, no shadows, no gradients, no texture, no 3D, no tiny circuit details. The mark must remain recognizable at 32 pixels. Under the main tile, display a small 48-pixel-scale duplicate of the SAME icon alongside the neatly typeset exact brand wordmark "Forkware"; this is a real small-scale legibility demonstration. At bottom, small label "01 / Fork W". Strong professional distinctive consumer-app branding, warm food cues with understated software hints. No phone mockup, no extra interface, no extra alternate symbols.
